basic_info.description: Positioned on the northwest corner of the 301 Mission tower, this sunlit 2-BD/2-BA corner home showcases dynamic views of the Downtown skyline & beyond. With floor-to-ceiling windows, wide-plank wood flooring, & a desirable split-bedroom layout, Grand Residence #30A has it all. The open-concept living & dining areas flow into a Studio Becker chef's kitchen appointed with Sub-Zero & Viking appliances. The primary bedroom is thoughtfully designed with a built-out walk-in closet & a spa-like bath featuring dual vanities, soaking tub, & glass-enclosed shower. 301 Mission ranks as one of the top high-service condominiums in San Francisco and now, following multiple years of construction, it's connected to bedrock. Amenities include 24/7 doorman, concierge, valet parking, and sophisticated security protocol. An amenities floor houses a 20,000-sf fitness & Pilates center, pool, screening room, owner's lounge, landscaped outdoor terrace with multiple fire-pits, wine storage, private dining room, social events, & more. Pampered by their five-star-trained staff, 301 Mission residents enjoy the daily benefits of living in a hotel-without the guests. Ideal downtown location in the tech and finance corridors, adjacent to Salesforce Park and minutes to the Ferry Building.
